name: Fish and Chips
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 3, line cook 3, poissonier 3

Flavor Profiles salty, texture, umami
Additional Ingredients bitter, sour, or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d6

DESCRIPTION

Fish and chips is a white fish breaded with egg and breadcrumbs served with fried potatoes and a side in which to dip both.

When consumed, it grants Deep Diver as a bonus feat for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each and also grant a water breathing effect, as the spell, for the duration.
